description: Seed Corpus run 38935736737: tpcds/clickhouse-local/sf1 failed in "Stage bundle" with "Corpus bundle contains unanonymized tuning diagnostics: platform.tuning.applied.statements[0..9]". `scripts/stage_seed_corpus_bundle.py` anonymizes via `AnonymizationManager.anonymize_result_payload` (benchbox/core/results/anonymization.py), which does not strip `platform.tuning.applied.statements`; only `ResultExporter._anonymize_applied_payload` (benchbox/core/results/exporter.py:344) does. Since #2863 local results keep those statements, so every seed cell that applies tuning is rejected by `unanonymized_tuning_findings` (benchbox/validation/bundle.py ~2250). The guard is correct; the shared anonymizer should apply the same treatment as the exporter.
